notes.title: Hotfix Patch: 0.11.2
Hotfix Patch: 0.11.1
NEW UPDATE - “BACK TO NORMAL”
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/ddb1e5a97eba9deb8431c45cce30e70c35dca848.png"]
Hi, Horde!

Two weeks... It's only been two weeks since the launch of the “Welcome to Hell” update, but for us, it feels like at least two months. More happened in the last fortnight than in the previous few, and we couldn’t be more thrilled! That said, we’re not stopping here. It’s time to introduce a new update to Be My Horde, and if you’ve read our previous announcements, you might already have an idea of what’s coming. So let’s dive into…

 
THE “BACK TO NORMAL” UPDATE


One of the biggest pieces of feedback we received was about the massive difficulty spike between Kingdom and Hell, and you were absolutely right. We’ve listened, learned, and realized what didn’t work. While the balance will still need fine-tuning in the future, we’re now introducing a new difficulty curve to smooth things out.


The former Kingdom becomes Kingdom Normal, and Hell becomes Hell Hard. Bridging the gap are two brand-new difficulty levels: Kingdom Hard and Hell Normal.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/0c6966c7fa72fdf564ca634aa56d6fe0f7881aa2.jpg"]


KINGDOM NORMAL
No changes here — this remains the same level you know and (hopefully) love. It’s still a great entry point for new players to learn how to play Be My Horde, and many of you continue to enjoy it. If you’ve already taken down King Richard, this is familiar territory.


HELL NORMAL
We’ve completely rebalanced and reworked the Hell level into one that now resembles Kingdom Normal in progression. The difficulty curve is gentler, making it easier for new players to adjust. You’ll face fewer high-tier units early on, requiring you to build your horde carefully with weaker ones before taking on more formidable foes. Environmental hazards have been toned down (both regular and those triggered by events) to match the new experience.


KINGDOM HARD
For those of you who found crushing Richard over and over again lost its charm as it’s too easy, here’s a fresh challenge. This version of Kingdom borrows some elements from Hell — tougher enemies appear early, which can either help you develop your horde quicker or be a huge challenge, depending on your skill. The Kingdom has a new face, and it’s not smiling.


HELL HARD
The one that stirred up so much chaos… is now even harder. Yes, we’ve restored the original, brutal “Welcome to Hell” launch experience. It’s a nightmare. A synonym for suffering. A walking abomination that will swallow you whole, chew you up, and spit you out in a blink. Yeah, we’re sick bastards... That said, with the introduction of Hell Normal and Kingdom Hard, you now have more ways to prepare. Practice, experiment, and sharpen your skills before facing this merciless challenge.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/60d826a115a4eb0cf3ad4c0c233470a0388ca8e9.gif"]



But remember, necromancy adepts: how you play is entirely up to you. Beating the “Hard” levels isn’t required to finish the game. If you’re a new player, both Kingdom Normal and Kingdom Hard are available from the start. Defeat King Richard III Ovine, and you’ll unlock both Hell levels. No achievements or incentives push you to play on harder difficulties — you’re free to experience Be My Horde at your own pace.



Want a chill time gathering undead buddies and spreading chaos without stress? Stick with Normal. Want to test your limits and maybe suffer a little? Hard is waiting.



We’d love your thoughts on this new four-tier structure. As mentioned, balance is still a work in progress, but we believe we’re heading in the right direction. All of today’s changes were possible thanks to your fantastic feedback, whether through Steam discussions, reviews, or our Discord server. Keep it coming! You’re helping us shape the best version of Be My Horde.


NOT THE END


This patch doesn’t just bring two new levels. We’ve also included fixes and minor changes — check out the full patch notes below for all the details!


Patch notes:


Changes:

💀 Added two new levels - Hell Normal and Kingdom Hard;

💀 Added stairs to the dance floor in the Hell level.



Fixes:

💀 Fixed King Dick jittering after the jump;

💀 Fixed the dialogue trigger after defeating King Richard;

💀 Improved the Devil Flight attack collision so it doesn't push Moriana or her minions.

💀 Fixed out-of-border achievements icons; 

💀 Fixed weird visual behaviour of the Kingdom starting location;

💀 The Undead Brigade perk that summons Imps now displays the correct number of summoned Imps.


WHAT’S NEXT?


We still plan to push some hotfixes in the next few days if necessary. But we also want to start thinking about the more distant future. We’ve learned a lot from the “Welcome to Hell” launch — even if it was a massive success, we know we made plenty of mistakes while releasing it, and we want to reflect, analyze, and grow from the experience. We see a huge potential in our game, and we don't want to waste it by rushing it - we want to give you a polished (pun very much intended) game! Thanks to your support and feedback, we know we will achieve that.



After some analysis and internal discussions, we’ll be back with more info about our next steps. One thing we can promise right now: we’re committed to making Be My Horde the best game it can be. We love working on it together with you! It’s such a great adventure, so we want to make it right. 



PRAISE BE MORIANA!

The Polished Games Team

Hotfix Patch: 0.10.4
Hotfix Patch: 0.10.3
Patch 0.10.2 — HE’S SUCH A D*CK
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/85d940c4b6b4a9a098a1cb0ceddd9e126463e922.png

Hello, Horde!

Two days ago, we unleashed hell—literally and figuratively. Our biggest update since Be My Horde launched was a massive success! Player numbers skyrocketed, we received a flood of new reviews, and we couldn’t be more excited. Thank you so much for playing and supporting the game!

But… not everything went perfectly.

We read your feedback, reviews, and comments—we're listening and constantly reviewing your input. One major issue you helped us uncover was a set of significant balance problems introduced in the "Welcome to Hell" update.

So today, we’re releasing a patch to tackle those issues. Let’s dive into the biggest one:

KING RICHARD IS SUCH A D*CK

Yep, he is… Thanks to your feedback (and months of hard work), the Kingdom level was previously well-balanced. Many of you enjoyed conquering the land and kicking Dick’s royal butt repeatedly. However, while working on the Hell level, we unintentionally introduced a hitbox bug that affected the entire Kingdom, especially the boss fight with King Richard.

Thanks to your sharp eyes and detailed notes, we identified and fixed the issue. With this patch, hitboxes should now function properly again. Here's what to expect:

💀 Killing King Richard is significantly easier;

💀 Enemy Mages are easier to kill, especially the first one;

💀 Paladins are more deadly and a bigger challenge in the early game, but will be more useful once turned undead.

How did such a major bug slip through the internal testing? It occurred late in the development process, when we were focused on iterating and testing Hell. During the final full game playthrough tests, we noticed the King fight became harder, but we couldn't find the exact issue causing this on time.

As the release deadline came, we applied a band-aid fix by reducing Richard's health to what felt to us was a similar difficulty before the patch. However, we got used to Hell's higher difficulty and missed the spot by a mile.

We are not trying to excuse ourselves; such things simply shouldn't happen. But we wish to give you more insight into what happened behind the scenes. We believe games should be good and work well on day one, even Early Access ones. You deserve that. And it wasn't the case for people who played the Hell update in the first 48 hours. For that, we apologize and promise to learn and do better in the future.

WHAT THE HELL IS WRONG WITH BALANCE

Before the Hell update, the majority of the negative feedback about that game was that it was too slow and not dynamic and engaging enough. So when we were designing Hell, we wanted to create a meaningful challenge for those who triumphed over King Richard.

Hearing the feedback from players who reached the new Hell level, we realize we went overboard and made it frustratingly hard. That’s on us. Many players, including us developers, love Be My Horde for the challenge and skill expression the game offers, and we have balanced the Hell level around those players. While there are many such players, they don't represent the majority.

We think the challenge is good, but it must still be fun for most players. Based on your feedback, we’ve rebalanced the Hell level, and this patch reflects that. With that said, this is only the first step of many to come in the upcoming days, so please keep your feedback coming—it’s incredibly helpful!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/b7e7d84ce52ae6a560adb7f8a12007adfd9c0316.png
The Polished Games team in the last couple days

FULL PATCH NOTES

Besides those most critical issues, we also address plenty of other things with this update. You’ll find the full patch notes below:

Kingdom Balance:
💀 Fixed issue with hitboxes on Kingdom level and restored balance to the intended state before the 0.10 update, resulting in the following changes:
💀 Killing King Richard is now significantly easier;
💀 Enemy Mages are easier to kill, especially the first one;
💀 Paladins are more deadly and a bigger challenge in the early game, but will be more useful once turned undead.

Hell Balance:
💀 Rebalanced Hell level to make it significantly easier;
This is just the first balance iteration of many to come in the following days.

Crashes:
💀 Fixed an issue with the animation plugin that could cause crashes.

Fixes:
💀 Fixed a bug that allowed Priests to heal the King;
💀 Fixed issue with free Perk Selector giving perks that are still locked behind achievements;
💀 Devil's music should now change correctly during enrage phases;
💀 Fixed a bug where dialogues were displayed incorrectly after changing Save Slots;
💀 Fixed incorrect player level display on the end screen;
💀 Fixed issue with the data collection notice appearing before all runs instead of only the first;
💀 Fixed stretched soul icon on the talents screen.

A FEW FINAL WORDS

We’ve made plenty of mistakes and will probably make more. But we’re committed to improving Be My Horde every step of the way. This game is a learning journey for us, and we’re learning a ton, thanks to you.

One common theme in the feedback and reviews is that the game has good foundations. If we fix the balance, it will be great. And we will get the balance right, with your help.

Thanks again for your support. Keep that feedback coming—it truly means the world to us!

KING IS A D*CK
The Polished Games Team

notes.title: Hotfix Patch: 0.10.1
NEW UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW - "Welcome to Hell"!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/7c5d3ec554bc9b08a02ee80f562252edd89b0812.png

Hello, Horde!

The hellish day has finally arrived! Things are heating up, and the flames of the underworld are rising. This is going to be one hell of a moment for us—and yes, we know, that’s already too many hell-themed puns in one paragraph. So let’s get to the point and say it together:

THE “WELCOME TO HELL” UPDATE IS LIVE!
(Moriana really hopes you read that out loud, minions)

March into the domain ruled by none other than the CEO of Hell himself—yep, the Devil—and convert his demon employees into your own grotesque yet oddly beautiful horde. But before you unleash doom upon another realm, let’s dive into what awaits. Because every crusade with Moriana deserves a proper briefing.

Without further ado... Welcome to Hell.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/6c61f5d2f6f46eaeb03239eb8a53839f146c8840.gif

HELLISHLY HAPPY PLACE

Hated your job? Think again. We’ve found somewhere worse—Hell. The biggest highlight of this update is a brand-new level—and no, it’s not just a flaming reskin of Richard’s Kingdom. We’ve crafted Hell to be a completely unique experience. Let’s break down what makes it so different.

First of all, we introduce a Hostile Environment. Back in the Kingdom, you could interact with map elements like trees or crops. In Hell, environmental hazards don’t just sit pretty—they actively try to kill you.

LAVA PITS
These randomly generated puddles of molten doom damage both Moriana and her minions, while leaving enemies unharmed. Watch your step! One new perk does let you turn them to your advantage, but more on that later...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/a1840ce660ba17a022571fedb0e9793f5efa6254.gif

EXPLODING BLOBS
Horrific blobs that detonate on contact. If they start glowing, step away—fast. Thankfully, they’re just as deadly to your enemies, so make good use of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/5fc35122a450e468c4d7e6d6716614ef75dd356a.gif

VOLCANOES
Speaking of explosions, Hell is full of them. Volcanoes are poorly secured (thanks, lazy demons) and highly explosive. Get too close, and they’ll erupt, causing a rain of destruction. Like exploding blobs, these can hurt your foes too, so use them strategically.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/8f8734b7be31cecbc79b73f18132b5d345960f9d.gif

But not all dangers come from your own missteps—regular events trigger some. In the Kingdom, you were constantly attacked by waves of enemies. It all also waits for you in Hell, but with some extra deadly phenomena.

BOMBARDMENT
The sky is literally falling. Rocks crash down during certain events, and unlike some other hazards, they only hurt you. Watch for danger zones and try to keep casualties low.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/5793eea19d554b46c372882b63d9d934a1f2bfe7.gif

FIRE TORNADOES
These flaming cyclones love to chase Moriana until they vanish on their own. Deadly and persistent, they’re drawn to her like moths to flame. (Because she’s hot. Obviously.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/fcbe0f229e536b1fb3eea0988ee3d60b8d1c6a1e.gif

We hope we have highlighted it enough—Hell is a dangerous place. And we haven’t even talked about who lives there...

DEMONS MAY DIE

A new realm means new enemies—and new minions. Back on Earth, you fought classic fantasy human units: peasants, knights, or mages. In Hell? Say hello to imps, goats, bombers, managers, directors, and... something that looks like a kettle full of tentacles.

There are six new units to claim for your horde, most of which are ranged attackers. This radically changes combat dynamics, so prepare for fresh tactical challenges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/4f20fff2ca08f85fc0fe9418271a211f6e4aceed.gif

IT’S GETTING COLD IN HERE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/d852f512a423b1cb5338476a06d8b5be1402b1f3.gif

Wherever Moriana goes, chaos follows. Life becomes death, love becomes hate—and vice versa. So naturally, her newest powers bring a chilling contrast to the fire and brimstone of Hell.

Introducing three brand-new abilities:

BLIZZARD
Summons icy swirls that appear periodically, damaging and freezing enemies, leaving them defenseless for a moment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/82b7b59ab7811f187c538014c721de3d7179b399.gif

ICE NOVA
Unleashes a frosty wave every few seconds, dealing damage and freezing nearby foes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/bf071193a0ef77970917628de81a3ba563e963de.gif

FROST BOLT
Fires cold projectiles when Moriana approaches enemies. Aim well—it’s easy to miss with poor positioning.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/6e6c0e5cd8707f05130785e5749aa4676b2c2c5b.gif

All these perks can be upgraded across multiple tiers, making them more powerful and valuable in battle. Experiment with them and gain a serious edge in battle.

Definitely test all new perks to become an even more formidable necromancess!

HELLISH EXPERIMENTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/cd6402f1a445c1fc171dc2431e9e37c39551315d.png

Demon souls work differently from human ones. You can’t use them to build structures in the Dominion or buy skins, but you can invest them in Hellish Experiments.

Spend hell souls to unlock talent points and boost your minions’ health, damage, fire resistance, and more. You’ll need every edge, especially when you face the big boss… Speaking of which…

THE CEO IS ANGRY

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/f788bf4b5e9692e49e385c7e19b7f126869b888a.gif

Every corporation has a boss. And this one is... the literal Devil. Bored, bitter, and bound to the bureaucracy of Hell, the Devil now faces a new HR nightmare: you. Moriana is an unholy fly in his infernal ointment—and he’s not happy about it.

But who knows? Maybe Moriana will melt his cold heart?... No, wait… opposite. Maybe Moriana will freeze his burning heart?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/8d819b85ac46384fe7a64f7e9172e15afc10df19.gif

Either way, prepare for a fight more intense than anything Richard III Ovine could dream of. Defeating the Devil unlocks a brand-new skin for our cold-hearted necromancess, so here’s your additional motivation to take him down!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/9e45d9c39309607630ef9df8c49907e5da8dfc08.gif

BURNING CHALLENGES

“Welcome to Hell” introduces a few new in-game challenges that unlock additional upgrades. Push yourself and earn your rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/6cbd51545449cbdcfad67a06173a3a5da3fb1c2f.gif

QUALITY OF (AFTER)LIFE IMPROVEMENTS

Looking at minor, but still essential, things, we added a new level selector. From now on, you can easily go back to the Kingdom if you decide that the temperature in Hell is too much for you, or if you just enjoy bullying King Richard over and over again. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/cc3f37f1d86d7a84b8e94c231a3383025efc1e15.png

Important note: You can now change the Hard Mode level or switch to the No Perk mode from this window. That said, the previous building for it is not obsolete as it serves now for the mentioned Hellish Experiments.

WHAT MORE?

Together with all this new content comes plenty of fixes and minor improvements. We have a few more announcements to celebrate this opportunity, so if you have come this far, you can check below to see what else we have in store.

TRAILER, Q&A SESSION, EVENT, AND A BUNDLE

We’ve also got a handful of extras to celebrate this infernal milestone!

First, we’re thrilled to unveil a brand-new official trailer for Be My Horde. The previous one has been with us since our Early Access launch, which feels like eons ago, and it no longer represents what the game has become. It was high time for an update, and we hope you’ll enjoy the fresh look!

[previewyoutube=MeMw7N3ifMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We know this announcement is packed, but you may still have some burning (hehe) questions. That’s why we’re hosting an official Q&A session with the developers of Be My Horde. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/230b690deb941fce42839c2a030d0702acdd3fe9.png

Join us on May 29th at 11:00 AM (PST) / 8:00 PM (CEST) on our YouTube and Twitch channels. We’ll be playing the game live and answering your questions from chat. Can’t attend live? No worries—drop your questions in the comment section below, and we’ll make sure to address them during the stream. We’d love to see you there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/d3c8a9654599bfe6def01f0fe11e1da4d799c81c.png

Also, we're excited to be part of Steam’s Zombie vs. Vampires Fest! Sure, Be My Horde doesn’t feature traditional vampires, but your minions are definitely zombies—rotting, shambling, and loyal to the bone. That makes us eligible, right? Dive into the event to discover great discounts, awesome demos, and plenty of bloodsucking fun. If undead chaos is your thing, this is your moment.

And finally, Be My Horde has joined a new bundle! We teamed up with Hyperstrange to bring you the “Be My Horde x Hordes of Hunger” bundle not long ago. If you already own our game, it’s the perfect time to check out what our friends are creating. Trust us—they’re worth the plunge.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/52606/Be_My_Horde_x_Hordes_of_Hunger/

That wraps up the big stuff. If you’ve made it this far, you’re a true servant of our Lady. Now go forth, conquer Hell, and share your feedback on Steam or Discord. We’re dying to hear what you think of this massive update.

PRAISE BE MORIANA!
The Polished Games Team

notes.title: "Welcome to Hell" update launching MAY 26TH!
LANGUAGE UPDATE - Portuguese-Brazilian added to Be My Horde!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/3a6ff86f83deb340db86c552bae75f1f732ea0ec.png

Olá, horda!

Last time, we promised you something — and we intend to keep that promise.
Of course, our team is currently 100% focused on delivering the Hell Update in May. The work is going great, and we can’t wait to finally let you conquer the kingdom of demons.
BUT, we also said we would introduce one more smaller update before that — and today’s the day.

SEJA MINHA HORDA!

A new language update for Be My Horde is here! From now on, you can experience Moriana’s crusade in Portuguese-Brazilian. We hope our player-friends from South America will have a blast!

This means that Be My Horde now supports five languages in total:
💀 English
💀 Polish
💀 German
💀 French
💀 Portuguese-Brazilian

We plan to add many more localizations to the game, but we want to do it properly and ensure top quality. We're working with a fantastic localization company that helps us achieve this. As you can imagine, it’s a costly process — so we're doing it step by step, one language at a time.
In the end, we hope to offer as many languages as possible in Be My Horde, especially for the full launch later this year.
If you’d like to see a particular language added, let us know in the comments!

That's it for today — a very brief announcement this time. Enjoy the new language option in Be My Horde, and slay some peasants on our behalf, would you?
Now, we return to Hell...

PRAISE BE MORIANA!
The Polished Games Team

DICK IS HERE! The boss update available now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/9b865f7e5e0bedeee2419c18d0e7a0c3d6aa6953.png

Hello, minions!

No long introductions this time. Without further ado, let’s dive into the biggest treat of the day: THE BOSS UPDATE IS AVAILABLE NOW!
This marks another monumental step forward on our development journey, and we’re absolutely thrilled to finally share it with you! Although Moriana wasn’t pleased that we were focused on another character for the last few weeks, we think she understands she’s not the most import…

Hey, minions! Here’s another member of the Polished Games. The previous one had to take a short vacation. Let’s quickly run through the exciting new stuff in Be My Horde and why you should be hyped about them.

RICHARD III OVINE JOINS THE FIGHT

Of course, let’s start with the star of the show. From now on, as you frivolously conquer the land of poor humans, reaching the 27-minute mark will summon the ruler of the land, who will take matters into his own hands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/f596f7ffb4793b10f6af1b9bce6b80aed43304a7.gif

Richard III Ovine is our very first boss in Be My Horde: a king who’s tough on the outside but soft on the inside. If it were up to him, he’d spend his days peacefully tending to his flock of sheep—his beloved companions. But don’t let his pastoral charm fool you; Richard is a formidable opponent. Armed with immense strength, he’s ready to smash substantial numbers of your minions with just one hit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/4aea1953ee8688b460ea077b2aab625d8d988617.gif

As dangerous as an entire army, he’s got a few tricks up his royal sleeves. Not only can he crush Moriana or her horde with his mighty weapon, but he’s also capable of leaping onto your forces, shattering the bones (at least all that have left in those undead bodies) of your loyal servants. His attacks fueled by the holy power are equally devastating, ready to incinerate his enemies. And that’s not all—some of his most terrifying abilities involve his fluffy friends. But... we’ll let you discover those surprises yourself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/247765a77ae19ee4cbdc12f04d99d01c151f5a2c.jpg

Richard isn’t alone, after all. Expect countless Paladins and Mages willing to lay down their lives to protect their king. However, this is also good news for you: Richard’s troops can be turned into your own horde after all. Ah, the beauty of necromancy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/43e074750958eb76806ee4b5dcfa710f63252559.gif

Defeating Richard will be no easy feat, but we believe you’ll all manage to put him down… eventually. From now on, slaying Richard also marks the official end of the level. After witnessing the gruesome animation of his demise, you’ll automatically complete the run and return to the Dominion. While some players previously challenged themselves to survive as long as possible, the focus now shifts to defeating the boss as swiftly as you can. And let’s not forget that the Hard Mode is still there and also influences this bearded ruler!

Oh, and speaking of Richard… doesn’t it make you wonder why Moriana has set her sights on conquering his realm? Well…

TALKING HEADS

This boss update isn’t just about epic combat. We’re also introducing improved dialogues with Moriana in the Dominion, along with brand-new conversations between her and Richard III Ovine! Yes, we’re finally bringing you more story in Be My Horde! To make the narrative shine, our chubby king is also fully voiced. Ryan Cooper (Injustice 2, Ghost Song, MADiSON, Stasis: Bone Totem) joins the cast to deliver spicy banter with our necromancess. Through their witty and dramatic exchanges, you’ll uncover more about Moriana’s past and her feud with Richard. We love how Ryan masterfully balances seriousness and humor in his performance, and we hope you will, too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/d3e9a921b6758527d921f1ad1fff0d19902edcbf.gif

No need to start a new save file to enjoy their interactions. However, improved dialogues between Moriana and the player will only be available on new playthroughs. They are triggered by getting to specific minute marks in the game, and most of you have probably already reached all of them by this point.
TIME TO ACHIEVE SOMETHING

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/9087761bbd31b3c7e46ad46f06937eceea82ebcd.gif

This update isn’t just about Richard and his fluffy army—we’re finally rolling out achievements! For now, there are over 20 to unlock. You can track your progress in gathering Unholy Deeds (as we call them) through a dedicated structure in the Dominion. We also take this opportunity to change the perks system a little bit - previously, some abilities could be unlocked by developing a special perks-oriented structure for your base. From now on, most of the perks will be available after getting specific achievements! That said, expect that after the update, some perks will vanish from your deck, but we know you’ll unlock them back very quickly! You are, after all, amazing necromancy adepts ready to ACHIEVE great things!

Also, don't worry—we refunded you all the souls you spent on developing the perks structure.

Currently, these are solely in-game achievements, but Steam achievements are in the pipeline. We just really want to design many more of them before that, but to do so, we need to implement more content first. So stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/265a3bfce2175cd4762303f19a0a551d818f74b7.png
FILLING THE SCREEN

With this update, we’ve also revamped Be My Horde’s UI! The new interface is more user-friendly, visually appealing, and smooth. We’ve overhauled not just the in-game UI but also the menus, ensuring everything is now clearer and easier to navigate.

We also had Steam Deck in mind while doing it, so expect the user interface to be even more polished (hehe) for the owners of Valve’s device. We know plenty of you prefer to experience malevolent crusades via it, so be sure we’re thinking of you all the time, ensuring that Be My Horde works great on Steam Deck! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/bfb1f41774789e538f67c5b217cc176810be4d99.png
FULL PATCH NOTES

To make this announcement super official, here are the full patch notes detailing all the latest changes, improvements, and fixes:
💀 Added Boss Fight with Richard III Ovine;
💀 Added in-game Achievements;
💀 Revamped all of the UI;
💀 Added dialogues between Moriana and Richard;
💀 Improved Moriana's portraits;
💀 Changed and improved 4 out of 6 dialogues between Moriana and the player in the Dominion;
💀 Added animations to structures in the Dominion;
Balance tweaks:
💀 Dark Ritual - Damage increased (x2). Duration increased (10 sec->15sec);
💀 Swift Decay Tier 2 - New version: Doubles the DURATION of the burst of SPEED from all sources;
💀 Summoning Circle - Tier 1 nerf (50% less units);
💀 Summoning Circle - Tier 2 is now Tier 3, Tier 3 is now Tier 2;
💀 Vampiric Strike - Buff for all tiers (1%->2%, 3%->4%, 5%->6%);
💀 Swift Decay - Perk that heals from crops is now higher tier (Tier 2->Tier 3);
💀 Bonds of Torment - New Tier 3 perk (5 targets);
💀 Bonds of Torment - Healing from a single target decreased (0.3->0.2);
💀 Healing urns - More groups of urns but smaller. The total number is almost the same;
💀 Fires of Abbys - Bigger flat damage but smaller percentage damage;
💀 Second Coming - Tier 2 uses Blood Harvest as a damaged tool.

THE POLISHED GAMES COLLECTION

Okay, we know that we launched only two games on Steam (one of them is still in Early Access), but hey, it means we can have our very own bundle! Don’t forget that you can get both Be My Horde and Realms of Magic in the nice package and now, with the Steam Autumn Sale running, it’s cheaper than ever! So, if you want to check out what else we cooked in the past and set out on a fantasy adventure, be sure to check out Realms of Magic!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42733/Polished_Games_Collection/

AND AN EPIC STORY CONTINUES

Of course, we’re just getting started. Introducing Richard III Ovine was a test of our ability to create thrilling boss fights and advance the story of Be My Horde. Now, it’s your turn to tell us: did we pass? Share your thoughts on this mighty king and his epic battle!

Looking ahead, future updates will bring new challenges, fearsome enemies, and lore-rich bosses as we continue building Moriana’s journey to becoming the most formidable necromancess in history. But first things first: go out there and slay the king! Richard III Ovine can’t wait to meet you on the battlefield.

Praise be Moriana!
The Polished Games Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499520/Be_My_Horde/

THREADS OF FATE UPDATE IS HERE! Be My Horde 0.7 available now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/6e1aa4811355887c17933c555f132d2afccaf14a.png

Hello, minions!

Long time no see, right? We bet you thought we ran off with your money and abandoned the project. Absolutely not!

In fact, we've been working hard these past few weeks to improve and polish (hehe) the Be My Horde gameplay before adding extra content. We still want to deliver new levels, enemies, and boss fights! But first, we really wanted to refine HOW you play Be My Horde. Based on your feedback—and once again, we thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all your reviews and opinions—we’ve made a few gameplay changes that make the game... well, less monotonous!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/102f4117b4ad5cd492745eb3e2719ce80949b59d.gif

Today, we're excited to release this new update - Threads of Fate! Be My Horde version 0.7 is now live! Below, you'll find detailed patch notes highlighting both gameplay and graphic changes. Plus, we’re announcing a brand-new contest for FANART! Interested? Let’s dive in!

WE HAVE PERKS

Threads of Fate introduces a new feature—PERKS. Now, during your run, after collecting a certain number of souls, you’ll be given the choice of three perks that can grant Moriana new abilities, expand her army, or enhance her necromancy powers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/e7e69e5fe1b6c5c6152b8b1908c1ce6e0ab20f0d.gif

This system replaces the Scrolls of Fate mechanic. Yes, no more unlocking and picking up Scrolls in the Dominion before your run. The reason for this change is simple—we wanted to make Be My Horde more dynamic and exciting right from the start. Many of you noted in your comments and reviews that the early moments of a run could feel dull, especially if it’s already your tenth run. The gameplay is now far more engaging—perhaps a little more random since you can’t fully customize your build before each run—but definitely more intriguing and unpredictable in the best way possible. It also lowers the entry barrier for new players while still offering a challenge to veterans with the beloved higher levels of Hard Mode.

Perks aren’t just Scrolls in a different form. This new system allowed us to implement many fresh abilities and skills that, when used strategically, can turn the tide of battle! You’ll unlock new perks via a special structure in the Dominion.

Now, speaking of the Dominion, don’t worry—these changes don’t mean we’ve scrapped it. Moriana’s lair still plays an important role. We’ve kept certain structures that provide permanent upgrades, such as increasing the size of your starting army, boosting Moriana’s health points, or enhancing her movement speed. We’ve even added a few new ones, like a structure that allows our necromancess to revive once during a run, giving you one more chance after failing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/07f2197fd4fd3dba61aeb177655d146e2b66a390.gif

Another structure lets you choose the type of necromancy you’d like to wield. There are three options to choose from. 

💀 Instant Resurrection, the basic one you're already familiar with, lets you smash the button to quickly resurrect fallen enemies. 

💀 Powerful Necromancy is slower but allows you to hold the button to expand the resurrection range, raising a massive group of minions in one blow. 

💀 Automatic Resurrection is also known to some players. In this feature, Moriana revives enemies on her own, with the resurrection speed depending on the level of the Abomination (the bloody tree in the Dominion).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/914a7086a80ebbaa38dc5045164702dcd2006bee.gif

And you can also unlock the power of re-rolling the drawn perks in the Dominion, so your base is still a vital element of your crusade.
We’ve even added a new building animation. How do you like it?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/e0e60c9915564e7d34f069de7669755cc63d70de.gif

We should leave one important note here: this update introduces very significant changes to the gameplay and progression system, as you can see. To fully experience the new changes, we recommend starting the game on a new save.

MORIANA, MORE BEAUTIFUL THAN EVER

We’ve spent a lot of time improving the visuals. Just like with the design, we wanted to avoid monotony in the art. So, our artists focused on variety. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/b12d0403529fd827ee8d442861406467b71da2b3.png

We now have more diverse corpse textures, and the weather effects have been greatly enhanced, allowing for more detailed and atmospheric shadows. We’ve also improved Moriana’s walking animation, and yes, we even made her smile from time to time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/8180231b069173db7f9c3777596d3674d9be2716.gif

The biggest upgrade, though, is that we’ve added animations to all the minions! Your Peasants and Warriors are now far less stiff... which is unusual for zombies, but who’s complaining?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/6d5fcde6d924e6438bf127e36932e6155759f028.gif

Of course, these are just the highlights. The full Patch Notes are below.

💀 New gameplay mechanic - Perks; when leveling up, choose 1 out of 3 possible gameplay-enhancing abilities. The strongest ones are hidden behind a time wall of 15 minutes and a selected combination of perks, so be sure to experiment;
💀 New Dominion buildings - enhance perk selection with buildings that increase available perks, grant rerolls, and free perks;
💀 New gameplay mechanic - self revive, if unlocked, on taking lethal damage rise again and continue spreading havoc;
💀 Removed Scrolls of Fate - scrolls of fate are now gone, but in their place, a new system rises. Select what necromancy will be used in the future run.

Balance tweaks:
💀 Reduced movement speed granted by Movement speed Dominion building;
💀 Reduced healing done by corrupting wheat crops;
💀 Changed many prices of buildings in the Dominion;
💀 Some buildings in the Dominion are now locked behind other buildings, not only the Abomination (the bloody tree).

Art:
💀 Added animations for units;
💀 Added new animations for Moriana;
💀 Added new VFXs;
💀 Added new corpses models;
💀 Added two new seasons (Spring and Fall) and new weather effects;
💀 Added dozens of new elements on the level, like trees, bushes, anthills, etc.
💀 Plenty of improvements to other animations and models.

Fixes:
💀 Fixed many UI navigation issues.

BECOME MORIANA’S ARTIST

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/44e44eee027f6b7991d24467764038e9879914b9.png

To celebrate this update, we’re launching a FANART contest! And yes, you could win our exclusive black box filled with Be My Horde merch. Here's how to participate:

1. Join our Discord server HERE.
2. Create your own fan art of our beloved necromancess for the following theme: MORIANA IN HER FREE TIME. Show us what you think Moriana does when she's not busy slaying innocents or expanding her undead army.
3. Submit your artwork in the FANARTS thread on our Discord by October 13th at 11:59 p.m. (CEST).
The winner will be chosen by our artists and announced on October 14th!

You will find the detailed Terms & Conditions HERE.

If you have any questions about the contest, please let us know!

That’s it for now, folks! Go try the new Be My Horde update, and make sure to enter our latest contest. As always, keep your feedback coming. Our little project keeps evolving, thanks to your support and reviews. With gameplay changes nearly complete, we’ll now shift our focus to delivering new content. Expect new levels, enemies, and boss fights in the coming months!

Take care and…

PRAISE BE MORIANA!
The Polished Games Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499520/Be_My_Horde/

Hello, minions!

As we pen these words, we're diligently working on the next update for Be My Horde. However, since this takes some time, we thought it’d be a great idea to offer you something smaller but equally superb in the meantime. Without further ado, we have THREE announcements for you!

BALANCING ON THE EDGE

Moriana asked us (and by that, we mean forced us) to tweak some numbers and introduce various changes to the game’s balance. We hear you all, and we read every piece of feedback and review. We noticed that some improvements and polishes to the balance were needed. So, feel free to download the new 0.6.5 version of Be My Horde, where we’ve implemented buffs and debuffs as necessary to enhance your experience. The full list of changes is below:

💀 Increased maximum number of available Scroll Points from 7 to 9;
💀 Blood Dust: Healing urn chance increased from 30% to 40%;
💀 Speed Dust: Increased speed buff duration from 4s to 5s; Speed urn chance increased from 30% to 35%;
💀 Great Plague: Increased spawn chance by 66.6%;
💀 Circle of Death: Increased number of spawned Peasants, Warriors, and Knights from 20 to 30; Increased number of spawned Cavalrymen from 10 to 15;
💀 Poisonous Ashes: Poison cloud duration increased from 7s to 15s;  Increased poison damage from 1 HP + 1% Max HP to 3 HP + 1.5% Max HP;
💀 Storyteller: Decreased priest healing from 8 HP + 60% Max HP to 8 HP + 20 Max HP%;
💀 Wooly Boomer: Increased sheep spawn rate by 100%
💀 Swift Decay: Decreased Scroll Point cost from 2 to 1; Increased speed buff duration from 4s to 5s.

“I LIKE PAIN”

To celebrate this minor update, we’re thrilled to announce a new contest—the Hard Mode Challenge! Once again, you can win THE OFFICIAL BE MY HORDE MERCH PACKAGE, which includes a scented candle in a glass cemetery vessel, a mug, a sheet of stickers, a pin, a lanyard, and an extra Be My Horde Steam key. 
So, what do you need to do for our Hard Mode Challenge?

1. Update your game to version 0.6.5.

2. Get as far as possible on the highest possible Hard Mode level. Both factors are crucial for your results. For example, a participant with a record of 23 minutes on the third Hard Mode level has a better result than a participant with a record of 30 minutes on the second Hard Mode level.

3. Submit your score by sharing a screenshot of your ending screen with your best result in the Your Score thread on our Discord server.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/972153566662ceb4f756fb6d8ed0ea9887ae9762.png

The participant with the best result submitted before August 15th, 11:59 p.m. (PT), will be announced as the winner! Detailed Terms & Conditions can be found HERE.

Let the toughest necromancy adept win!

Also, remember that to unlock the Hard Mode, you first need to finish the game by reaching the 30-minute mark and building a special structure in your Dominion. Then, to unlock each next Hard Mode level, you need to once again reach the 30-minute mark on the lower level.

CHEAPER MINIONS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/5cc28542f06143bfd36e989dae68df9f5bc26bc7.jpg

Last but not least, we present you with a two-week 10% discount for Be My Horde. It’s not free, but we hope that if you’ve been waiting for a sale to recommend Rendezvous with Moriana to your friends and family, now is the time to do it!

More info about future updates will be coming soon! We can’t wait to show you what we’re working on.

Praise be Moriana, 
The Polished Games Team

notes.title: Changes in Be My Horde, the upcoming announcement, or HOW ARE WE DOING PART 2?
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/3588b817d97512f777315b6745f660df00e020be.png

Hello, minions!

How are you today? Have you slain any knights lately? Did you remember to show love to Moriana? Let us know, and in return, we’ll tell you How We Are Doing!

Well, it’s amazing for our team to compare the Be My Horde demo with the full game we’re currently working on—in terms of visuals and gameplay solutions, they are VERY DIFFERENT TITLES. And we’re thrilled to share some insights with you very soon.

Before we delve into some details, we want to thank you—as always and monotonously, but sincerely—for your support! Thank you for playing the demo, sharing your feedback, and sometimes just sending us a “hello” message on our Discord server. It all means a lot to our small team of passionate geeks who have created the game about the sexy necromancer.

Okay, shall we?

BE MY HORDE IS CHANGING

As we already teased, Be My Horde has undergone significant changes in the last month. We were in Boston at PAX East at the end of March, and that event gave us such a huge boost that in the last four weeks (which felt like a full year!), we've greatly improved our upcoming game. We’re talking about new units, new visuals, new interactive elements in the levels, completely new features, and… we’re not going to show any of it to you just yet :(. We apologize for teasing so much, but we really want to do it properly. You know, make one big strike combined with a huge announcement... And by “huge,” we mean “gigantic.” In 5-6 weeks, we should be ready to present a new trailer with a piece of very cool and intriguing news. All we can say now is to stay tuned because soon a lot of things are going to happen, and we hope you’ll help us make some noise around Be My Horde.

At this moment, all we can offer is this small, regular screenshot from the current version we’re working on. It has some work-in-progress elements in it, so a few things are about to change, but just compare it to the available demo, and you’ll see how much we’ve added and changed in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/8eed7f94a4e853f3ed8f40c9413c5b40fdf1ac06.png

HOW WE KILLED UI

As we speak, we’re also editing the next video devlog where we’ll take a closer look at something that Be My Horde pretty much doesn’t have: the User Interface. From the very beginning of this project, we wanted to create a simple, almost non-existent UI, but it wasn’t as easy a task as you can imagine. It had its challenges, enough to make a full video out of it. If you nerds are interested in such details about the game development process, then stay tuned; we should share the devlog in the first half of May.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/3722ddb7bd7e91e7635616b30cae95bc0ecd8382.gif

MAY YOU BE MY HORDE

And speaking of May, we’re planning another exciting and fun contest in the upcoming month for all of you, where you’ll have the chance to win not only a Steam key to the full version of Be My Horde upon its launch but also some cool goodies. We should share more info very soon; in the meantime, be sure to keep testing your skills in the demo as the mentioned contest will once again be connected to it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/43beec25fbf3e06af9c2fe6b2ea22a180863d4a9.gif

HORDE OF DRAGONS

In other, less vital news for you, we’re going to attend the upcoming Digital Dragons event in Kraków, Poland. We won’t be showcasing Be My Horde there, but it’s still a great opportunity for us to integrate and spend some time not just in front of our computer screens. It’s also going to be a great opportunity for our marketing guy to do some networking, when we’ll be having some fun. A good moment to relax a little bit right before the aforementioned huge announcement.

That’s it for now. We’re aware that we didn’t actually share any detailed information, but trust us when we say that very soon, you won’t be able to open your fridge without encountering some news about Be My Horde. We’re gathering strength and resources to shower you with some cool stuff in the near future. Remember to wishlist the game to not miss any of it. notes.title: Demo Update - Improvements and Fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366003/4084ba5a731f2eb91901130c035f70c332bfa54d.png

Hello, Horde!

Yesterday, we've decided to extend the availability of the Be My Horde demo and today we also rolled out an update for it, addressing various issues and implementing improvements to enhance the user experience! While no new content has been added, we’ve wanted to properly polish the demo with meticulous care. Below, you'll find the patch notes:

Changes:
💀 Improved the music track by adding additional instruments.
💀 Added fullscreen, resolution, and VSync options.
💀 Increased Horsemen Health Points and mass.
💀 Changed the cursor to hide when inactive for 3 seconds during gameplay.
💀 Added background image to pause menu.
💀 Improved combo boxes.

Fixes:
💀 Resurrection has been adjusted to prevent unexpected target switching during casting.
💀 Disabled pause during dialogues.
💀 Controller disconnection no longer results in gameplay issues on the keyboard.
💀 Controller functionality will now gracefully deactivate when the application loses focus.
💀 Fixed the issue where longer button presses would cause menu flickering.
💀 Fixed the issue that caused resurrection to continue casting after opening the pause menu.
💀 Fixed the issue that caused low health warnings to not get removed by health regeneration.
💀 Removed black bars appearing on ultrawide monitors while in windowed mode.
💀 Removed the default outline in the user interface.

PRAISE BE MORIANA!
The Polished Games Team
